PR.body:
## Problem and scope

PR101 completed the source-pinned maximum-hazard/mean-first-entry CE envelope and already derived the backward survival equation. This stacked consumer computes channel-resolved first H1 1s→2s/2p event probabilities and event energy/time rewards on a newly assembled finite EE chain, using unchanged PR59 and PHYS83 providers and saved C23D source atoms.

## S0 preparation

- Base Documents D: b65befa5187d3e1e11574a98dcadd2032831de72.
- S0: ad3634c029dcff722602dc139fb726142935f88c; exact ref R1 PASS.
- Seven-repository survey: 1,321 branch refs / 856 open PRs, all 14 collections exhausted over 29 pages at 04:41:26–04:43:17 UTC. Latest owner returns and accessible backups/conversation excerpts are separately scoped.
- Independent R6: PASS_SCOPED_R6, blocking 0. Standard Feynman–Kac and prior PR101 survival derivation reused.
- New input: n5_ce_resolvent_input_20261024_v1; T=10000 K, ne=0.14 cm^-3, prescribed lnLambda=20, n_H1(1s)=0.9 cm^-3, initial 0<W<10 eV, chi={1.5,3}, reflecting R={40,80}.
- Exact q/10eV/CE-threshold grid knots prevent an initially CE-active projection. Positive channel RHS avoids rare-probability cancellation.

## Current execution

Ten targeted controls passed. Primary v1 stopped after one completed case due to a local input-variable shadowing defect. Its raw results/costs are retained. A minimal variable rename and one targeted regression are authorized before a new v2 run; no numerical admission is claimed by this S0 checkpoint.

## Preserved gates

PHYS84 numerical admission WAIT, PHYS85/86 owner work and full HE-ANG source-input gate remain. Missing channels/rates stay null. Full N4/N5 remain PARTIAL/OPEN; N6/N7 not activated. No ODE, source/rate quadrature, historical science replay, NCP dispatch, main merge or full-network claim. global_error_bound/global_completion_percent remain null. S0 Library/Dropbox backup ACKs will be added in a later receipt; historical Drive UNKNOWN states are preserved.
